newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla cattle trade slow, some at $69-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla cattle trade slow, some at $69-USDA.

text.p: Trade slow in the panhandle area Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers not well established, few sales 1.00 lower.

Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 500 slaughter steers and 500 heifers; 68,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,500 formulated and 1,200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 69.00.
Confirmed: 1,000 Week Ago: 6,500 Year Ago: Holiday
Wk to Date: 68,300 Week Ago: 70,800 Year Ago: 39,600
